notes: Short dark-and-stylish cut of the floating light shelf from Rameez's three phone clips only (IMG_7745 polish, IMG_7747 track, IMG_7749 three). No AI stills, so no Meta AI disclosure is needed on this one. The source is a bright daylight workshop (measured grey means 117/132/144, p5 28/60/61), so the stock `noir` grade (brightness -0.30, contrast 1.50) would have crushed the craftsman and the plank to black. This brief overrides it with a midtone-crushing curve that leaves the highlight knee alone: the room falls away, the inset LED line stays hot, and the polish clip is lifted back +0.05 per shot because it has no LED to carry it. Structure is light -> hand -> three: open on the glowing channel (the strongest frame in the footage), cut to the maker, pay off on the three lit shelves. Hook scores 10/12 on hooks.py, all three gates. No claim is made that the shelves are on a wall, because the footage shows them on a workshop table.
